selection_basis: Storage/handling remains 38 questions below its 60-question production target after B3 verified 22 questions. B19 uses the still-ready e-Gov Decree/Rule storage-and-handling source path to cover materially distinct facility-specific, exception and operational boundaries not represented by B3 general common standards, gasoline container-sale controls or container-stacking questions.

pinpoint_scope: 危険物の規制に関する政令 第24条以降の貯蔵・取扱い基準のうちB3未使用の施設別・例外・操作境界に関する該当条項
危険物の規制に関する規則 第38条の4〜第40条の14のうちB3未使用の貯蔵・取扱い基準、例外および施設別運用に関する該当条項
source_contract.locator_rule: Every candidate must bind to one registered current e-Gov source/version and one exact article/paragraph/item. The answer-defining proposition must be a storage/handling rule at a facility, not a transport/transfer rule and not an unsourced general safety inference.

planned_families: facility-specific storage and handling conditions not covered by B3 common-rule propositions
tank, warehouse, filling, dispensing or transfer-within-facility operating boundaries where current law explicitly defines them
specific statutory exceptions and prerequisite conditions within Rule Chapter 5
container filling, closure, placement or handling details materially distinct from B3 container integrity and stacking-height questions
numeric, timing, distance, capacity or procedural boundaries only where directly defined by one registered provision
prohibited-action versus permitted-condition decisions that remain within storage/handling rather than transport or incident response
anti_duplication_rule: Do not recreate B3 C001-C024 propositions, including the common Article 24 controls, Class-4 Article 25 fire/vapor rule, generic exception-structure questions, hazard grades, generic container framework, gasoline container-sale identity/purpose/record duties or 3m/4m/6m stacking boundaries. Do not overlap B10/B13 transport/transfer propositions.
